title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes represents the ultimate battle to determine the current queen of speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Droves of spectators file into Nakayama Racecourse to bear witness to the lightning-fast showdown.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Vroom, vrrroommm! Rev your engines, 'cause Rubae's in the house! Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Are you guys out there on the dance fl—uhhh, I mean, in the stands—feeling the vibes or what?! Can I get a "wa-heyyy"?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Wuh, heyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey, wahey! Wahey-hey! Let's crank the cheers up to ★ e-lev-en! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha… I should've guessed that extra-loud voice was Helios.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But… just so you know, Zephyr, Ruby's not an opponent you want to take lightly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still, knowing you…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I've been feeling it nonstop since this morning—this sensation of being pierced by a northwester…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (This must be…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Am I… nervous?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ruby… Hello.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I feel it in my gut. Whenever I'm exposed to the sheer ambition emanating from the heavenly wind that blows about her…)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …Was there something you wished to say to me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …No.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I was but a gentle breeze during our partner running session… But today, I will show you the rushing wind I've become.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …By all means.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I, too, will become that which I must.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Supreme. Magnificent. Peerless. Absolute. Such is my one purpose.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I exist to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The pressure… The sheer nobility… It's overwhelming.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But I'm in this too!
